formal_statement: ∃ (V : Set (List Bool × List Bool)) (a : ℕ), PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair V ∧ (∀ y c : List Bool, (y, c) ∈ V → y ∈ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.PartialMCSP) ∧ ∀ (n s t : ℕ) (T : List (Option Bool)) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool), T.length = 2 ^ n → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Consistent n T f → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n f t → t ≤ s → ∃ c : List Bool, c.length ≤ a * (n + t + 1) ^ 2 ∧ (List.replicate s true ++ false :: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.encodePartial T, c) ∈ V
plain_statement: There is a polynomial-time relation V, sound for partial MCSP on every string, such that an instance with a consistent function of circuit size t at most the bound s has a V-witness of length at most a (n + t + 1)^2, independent of the table length 2^n. Our own strengthening of L-meta-021; the witness is one row, expanded by the verifier. Needed by L-meta-016.
title: Partial MCSP has a verifier whose witness is short when the circuit is small
